50798.meaning1: sweet voiced; with a lovely tone
50798.commentary: (DNa) mañjussaro'ti akharassaro. (ANa) mañjussarānan'ti madhurassarānaṃ. (JAa) mañjussaro'ti sundarassaro. (DNt) mañjussaro'ti saṇhassaro. yo hi saṇho, so kharo na hotī'ti āha akharassaro'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, himavante pabbate karavīkā nāma sakuṇajāti mañjussarā ca vaggussarā ca madhurassarā ca pemaniyassarā ca, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemaniyassaro ca.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mañjussarānaṃ yadidaṃ lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo.
